final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT m.Name AS n, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS a, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS b FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.n AS n, s1.a AS a, s1.c AS c, s1.a - s2.b AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.b IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.b) SELECT AVG(a), AVG(c), AVG(d) FROM s3
